actors.title: Actors to evaluate
actors.description: Actor IDs or names (e.g. `apify/website-content-crawler`). Each Actor is run with the prefilled input from its input schema.

iterations.title: Runs per Actor
iterations.description: How many times each Actor is run.

maxConcurrentRuns.title: Max concurrent runs
maxConcurrentRuns.description: How many evaluated runs (across all Actors) are in flight at the same time. Each in-flight run is polled every few hundred milliseconds after it finishes, so keep this reasonable to stay under API rate limits.

inputOverrides.title: Input overrides
inputOverrides.description: Optional per-Actor input merged over the prefilled input, keyed by the Actor ID/name exactly as given in `actors`. Example: `{ "apify/website-content-crawler": { "maxCrawlPages": 1 } }`.

fastPollIntervalMillis.title: Fast poll interval (ms)
fastPollIntervalMillis.description: How often the run cost is fetched while it is (or recently was) changing.

slowPollIntervalMillis.title: Slow poll interval (ms)
slowPollIntervalMillis.description: Poll interval used once the cost has not changed for `slowdownAfterMillis`. Any change switches back to the fast interval.

slowdownAfterMillis.title: Slow down after (ms)
slowdownAfterMillis.description: How long the cost must stay unchanged before switching to the slow poll interval.

stableWindowMillis.title: Stable confirmation window (ms)
stableWindowMillis.description: How long the cost must stay unchanged before it is considered stabilized.

maxTrackingMillis.title: Max tracking time per run (ms)
maxTrackingMillis.description: Give up tracking a run after this long past its finish and mark it as not stabilized.

runMemoryMbytes.title: Run memory (MB)
runMemoryMbytes.description: Memory for the evaluated runs. Uses each Actor's default when empty.

runTimeoutSecs.title: Run timeout (seconds)
runTimeoutSecs.description: Timeout for the evaluated runs. Uses each Actor's default when empty.

runBuild.title: Build
runBuild.description: Build tag or number to run. Uses each Actor's default build when empty.

maxTotalChargeUsd.title: Max total charge per run (USD)
maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Cost limit for each evaluated run of a pay-per-event Actor. Uses the platform default when empty.
